status: Proposed after V-JEPA test, before SAM2 held-out scores were viewed; not a new primary outcome.

definition.event: Existing recovery/is_recovery label only: first unambiguous visible tubelet after absence.
definition.latency: Difference between tubelet first-frame indices; two-frame resolution, not exact per-frame recovery time, wall-clock latency, or causal detection delay. V-JEPA predictions are offline within encoder windows.
definition.hit: Saved correct localization hit on a visible target; later hits after renewed absence belong to another episode.
definition.ambiguity: Observed but unscorable tubelets; never hits; retained and reported, not silently excluded.
definition.censoring: New full absence, clip end, or missing row truncates follow-up. Success before censoring stays known. New absence is a known episode interruption, not unknown recovery; only clip end/missing rows leave an unrecovered outcome unresolved.
definition.fully_observed: Every expected tubelet through the horizon is present before renewed absence; ambiguous states may occur.
definition.rates: Complete-horizon rates use their explicit denominator. Overall bounds leave unresolved censored outcomes unknown; no imputation.
definition.limits: Descriptive analysis of saved predictions, with repeated parts/events within clips; no frame-independent inference or model rerun.
